summary: Samvera Hyrax provides a web front-end interface for browsing and managing digital repositories built on the Samvera framework. It runs as a Ruby on Rails application designed to interact with Fedora-based backend storage systems. The software is targeted at organisations needing to organise, curate and serve academic or cultural heritage collections.
goodFor: It suits university libraries and archival institutions implementing institutional repositories using the Samvera and Fedora stack.
watchOut: You face a complex operational stack due to the dependency on both the Ruby on Rails application layer and the underlying Fedora repository architecture.
deployNotes: You will typically need to provision a relational database, a persistent storage volume for uploaded assets, and configure a reverse proxy to handle TLS termination for the Ruby application.
